# HikeWise — Full Documentation for LLMs

> HikeWise is a smart study companion app that helps students build better focus habits through AI-powered insights, gamified progress tracking, and virtual study rooms. Built by Dr. Nikolai Lee (educator, 3,000+ students taught) and Jacken Holland (developer). Available on iOS and Android.

## Website

- URL: https://hikewise.app
- Summary version: https://hikewise.app/llms.txt

---

## About HikeWise

HikeWise was founded on the observation that student success comes down to two things: habits and focus. After teaching over 3,000 students, Dr. Nikolai Lee saw the same pattern — it wasn't talent or intelligence that determined academic outcomes. Students who built consistent study routines and maintained focus outperformed everyone else.

HikeWise combines evidence-based study techniques (active recall, spaced repetition, the Pomodoro technique, deep work) with intelligent tracking and AI-powered insights. The app is designed as a study habit tracker that helps students take control of how they learn.

Every feature is informed by Dr. Lee's clinical training in neuroscience and learning science, and built with the technical expertise of Jacken Holland, a full-stack developer who has shipped products across 20+ countries.

## Product Features (Detailed)

### Focus Sessions
Timed study intervals based on proven productivity techniques:
- **Balanced Mode** (25/5 minutes): Classic Pomodoro-style intervals for general studying
- **Sprint Mode** (15/3 minutes): Short bursts for review, flashcards, or light reading
- **Deep Work Mode** (50/10 minutes): Extended focus blocks for complex problem-solving, writing, or deep comprehension
- Session tracking with automatic break reminders
- Daily and weekly session history

### Nora AI — AI Study Companion
- Personalized study recommendations based on your patterns
- Concept explanations and question answering
- Smart reminders to maintain study consistency
- Adapts to your study habits over time
- Available in the app during and between study sessions

### Virtual Study Rooms
- Co-working spaces to study alongside friends or other students
- Real-time presence indicators showing who's currently studying
- In-room chat for quick questions and motivation
- Invite friends via shareable links
- Public and private room options

### Leaderboards & Gamification
- Daily, weekly, and monthly rankings
- Points earned for completed study sessions
- Study streaks with loss-aversion mechanics
- Badges and achievements for milestones
- Friendly competition to maintain motivation

### Progress Analytics
- Detailed study habit tracking with charts and trends
- Session duration, frequency, and consistency metrics
- Subject-level breakdown of study time
- Weekly and monthly reports
- Goal progress visualization

### Study Streaks
- Daily streak tracking to build consistency
- Visual streak calendar
- Streak freeze protection (planned)
- Milestone celebrations at key streak counts

### Academic Goals
- Set targets for daily/weekly study hours
- Subject-specific goal tracking
- Progress bars and completion indicators
- Notification reminders for goal deadlines

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### General
**What is HikeWise?**
HikeWise is a comprehensive study app designed to help students focus better, track their progress, and achieve their academic goals. It combines focus timers, study rooms, leaderboards, and an AI study companion named Nora.

**Who is HikeWise designed for?**
HikeWise is perfect for students of all ages, from high school to graduate school. Whether you're preparing for exams, working on projects, or just want to build better study habits, HikeWise can help.

**Is HikeWise free to use?**
Yes! HikeWise offers a generous free tier with access to focus sessions, basic progress tracking, and study rooms. Premium features like advanced analytics and unlimited AI assistance are available with a subscription.

### Features
**What are Focus Sessions?**
Focus Sessions are timed study intervals based on proven productivity techniques. Choose from Balanced (25/5 minutes), Sprint (15/3 minutes), or Deep Work (50/10 minutes) modes to match your study style.

**How do Study Rooms work?**
Study Rooms are virtual co-working spaces where you can study alongside friends or other students. You can see who's currently studying, chat with room members, and stay motivated together.

**Who is Nora?**
Nora is your AI study companion built into HikeWise. She can answer questions, explain concepts, provide personalized study recommendations, and send smart reminders to keep you on track.

### Account
**How do I create an account?**
Download HikeWise from the App Store or Google Play, then sign up with your email or continue with Google/Apple. You'll be studying in under a minute!

**Can I use HikeWise on multiple devices?**
Yes! Your HikeWise account syncs across all your devices. Start a session on your phone and check your progress on your tablet.

**How do I delete my account?**
You can delete your account in the app under Settings > Account > Delete Account. All your data will be permanently removed within 30 days.

### Technical
**Which devices are supported?**
HikeWise is available on iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android devices. We recommend using the latest version of your operating system for the best experience.

**Does HikeWise work offline?**
Basic features like Focus Sessions work offline. However, features like Study Rooms, Leaderboards, and Nora AI require an internet connection.

### Study Science
**What study techniques does HikeWise support?**
HikeWise is built around evidence-based study methods including active recall, spaced repetition, the Pomodoro technique, deep work sessions, and time blocking. These techniques are validated by decades of cognitive science research.

**Is HikeWise backed by research?**
Yes. Dr. Nikolai Lee's dual background in clinical science and education informs every feature. All blog content cites peer-reviewed research from cognitive psychology, neuroscience, and education science.

**How does the Pomodoro technique work in HikeWise?**
HikeWise offers three Pomodoro-inspired modes: Balanced (25 min focus / 5 min break), Sprint (15/3), and Deep Work (50/10). Each is designed for different study contexts — from quick review to deep comprehension work.

### Privacy & Data
**Is my study data private?**
Yes. Your study data is stored securely and never sold to third parties. HikeWise is designed as a personal study tool — your data belongs to you.

**Can my school see my study data?**
No. HikeWise is a personal app. Your institution has no access to your study data, sessions, or analytics.

**What data does Nora AI collect?**
Nora only analyzes your study patterns within the app (session lengths, frequencies, subjects) to provide personalized recommendations. No external data is collected.
